{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma3
|version1= 1.00

|descr= Return value1 raised to the power of value2. Identical to [[a ^ b]]. {{Feature|important|Use [[a ^ b]] as it is 5 times faster.}}

|s1= [value1, value2] call [[BIS_fnc_pow]]
